architecture.domain: WallpaperPlaybackPort.library/prepare/play/preview exchange pure domain values. WallpaperPreviewOptions checks physical contain bounds; WallpaperFrameRate distinguishes source timing and a checked cap.
architecture.adapter: NativeVideoWallpapers pins a read-only regular source descriptor, validates media and decodes/fits frames. Preview creates no import, poster or preferences. Existing background fit and alpha policy are unchanged.
architecture.client: Shared wallpaper_carousel composition owns cards, captions and controls. Preview owns transient demand, generations, retirement acknowledgement, five-entry cache and bounded latest-frame delivery; only explicit Apply delegates prepare and root persistence.
architecture.framework: Existing ImageStream, prepared images, controlled scrolling, motion, generic subscriptions and Vulkan rendering remain reusable. Subscription spawn failures retain their exact source identity.

visual_checks.scope: Offscreen software Vulkan images and structural assertions, separate from native input and animation sampling.
visual_checks.initial_broad_local_run: Intentionally stopped after 267 actual images for focused review; never claimed complete.

native.scope: One existing 1x native output; synthetic animated GIF carousel and monitor-specific Apply
native.scope_of_pixel_evidence: Private 24×24 interior samples changed synthetic fixture colors. No full native UI, FPS, smoothness, decoder-count, scanout or physical-GPU claim.
native.accepted_harness: 600-second foreground bound, 64-step navigation bound, guarded direct visible-card clicks and bounded forward/backward Tab; unchanged per-input/cohort/persistence/restoration guards.

remaining: Native decoder-body count and source-cadence/60FPS/smoothness measurements. Serialization is established by source and mock lifetime tests.
